```http
GET /v1/emails/{id}
```

Metadata only. Never returns variables, tokens or the recipient. Another project's or environment's message is a 404.

## Authentication

Send a server-side API key: `Authorization: Bearer $NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY`. See [Authentication](/docs/authentication).

Required scope: `emails:read`.

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | &nbsp; |

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_URL")+"/v1/emails/6f1c2d0e-3b52-4d49-9a43-7d1f0c5e8a11", nil)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY"))
	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	out, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
	fmt.Println(res.StatusCode, string(out))
}
```

## Responses

### 200

Status

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (uuid) | no | &nbsp; |
| `status` | "queued" \| "scheduled" \| "submitting" \| "submitted" \| "retry_wait" \| "failed" \| "unknown" \| "expired" \| "captured" \| "cancelled" | no | &nbsp; |
| `template` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `template_version` | integer | no | &nbsp; |
| `attempts` | integer | no | &nbsp; |
| `smtp_reply` | string | no | The mail server's acknowledgement text (queue id) once submitted. |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | no | &nbsp; |
| `updated_at` | string (date-time) | no | &nbsp; |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) | no | &nbsp; |
| `submitted_at` | string (date-time) | no | &nbsp; |
| `completed_at` | string (date-time) | no | &nbsp; |
| `metadata` | map of string to string | no | &nbsp; |
| `events` | array of object | no | &nbsp; |
| `events[].type` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `events[].reason` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `events[].at` | string (date-time) | no | &nbsp; |

### 401

invalid_api_key. The response carries `WWW-Authenticate`.

Header `WWW-Authenticate`: string

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

### 403

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ip_not_allowed"
  }
}
```

### 404

not_found. An unknown id, or one that belongs to another project or environment.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "not_found"
  }
}
```

## Error codes

Errors share one shape: `error.code` is stable, `error.message` is optional detail. Retry only timeouts, network errors, `429` and `5xx`, with the same idempotency key; fix the request for every other `4xx`.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | Missing, wrong, revoked or expired key |
| `ip_not_allowed` | 403 | The caller's address is not on the key's allowlist |
| `missing_scope` | 403 | The key lacks the scope this call needs |
| `not_found` | 404 | Unknown id, or one that belongs to another project or environment |

Every code is explained on [Rate limits and errors](/docs/api/rate-limits-and-errors).
